lines: I was really looking forward to spending time with you.
But when you wanted me to hurry, I felt like I was doing something wrong.
I don't want to feel rushed when I'm with you.

choices.text: I was pushing you. I'm sorry.
I don't think I did anything wrong.

lines: I still want to spend time together. Just... can we go at our own pace?
That would mean a lot to me.
I understand if you don't see it the same way.
But I was uncomfortable. That should matter too.
